summary: Aurora Cannabis filed a 6-K attaching an October 14, 2026 news release in which its board, on the unanimous recommendation of a Special Committee, urged shareholders to REJECT Curaleaf Holdings' revised hostile bid for all issued and outstanding Aurora common shares and to TAKE NO ACTION. The revised bid was set out in Curaleaf's October 6, 2026 Notice of Variation, Change and Extension and remains open until December 4, 2026. Advisors included an unnamed financial advisor providing an updated inadequacy opinion and Kingsdale Advisors as depositary/information agent; a Notice of Change to the Directors' Circular will follow. The board argues the offer undervalues Aurora, would be partly funded by Aurora's own cash, and shifts risk via inflated Curaleaf stock. Watch for a superior strategic alternative, tender withdrawals, or an improved bid before the December 4 expiry.
